confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live menus, prices or listings. Restaurant, cafe and beer anchors are moderate confidence. July peak-season accommodation is least certain and varies widely by area and booking date. Cocktail and wine anchors were set using local price relationships to the beer anchor, since direct knowledge is weaker. USD values assume a EUR-USD rate near 1.15 from general knowledge, not a live quote. The FX figure comes from search-result summaries citing rba.gov.au; I did not open the RBA page directly, and search snapshots may lag the live page.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other major Italian heritage cities with similar tourist demand, such as Rome and Bologna, adjusted for the tourist-heavy historic centre and July peak-season hotel demand.
